workload: Memory-heavy chronological sklearn tabular model-family search

observations.outcome: Search reached a durable boundary but consumed substantially more compute than the final evidence justified.
Single-worker execution was operationally stable; the search family remained incomplete.
Multi-process plus internally threaded numerical libraries caused libgomp failures and memory-bandwidth contention.
The selected sklearn tree workload did not justify GPU execution; evidence and data quality were limiting.

recommendation.gpuPolicy: Require explicit estimator support and an evidence-based need.
recommendation.dataPolicy: Materialize reusable folds once and avoid per-process copies of memory-heavy panels.
